source_title: LG Refrigerator - How to Install Your Refrigerator Water Filter
filter_location_text: LG support guidance for French-door models describes the filter housing in the upper back-left interior area and notes that obstacles such as the top-left shelf may need to be moved for full access.
replacement_steps_summary: LG support guidance describes opening the filter housing, removing the old filter, inserting and seating the replacement filter, and closing the housing before returning the refrigerator to normal use.
cautions: LG support guidance notes a small amount of water may drain during replacement, recommends flushing about 2.5 gallons after installation, and says to hold the Water Filter button for about 3 seconds to reset the indicator.
notes: Tier 1 manufacturer-support bundle for LRFVS3006S using official LG support/product/spec/help sources. This record intentionally avoids owner-manual claims and keeps wording conservative to manufacturer support guidance.
